hook: Lensed gravitational waves could warn of neutron-star mergers hours to days ahead, in simulation.
summary: Gravitational lensing can delay and repeat a merger signal so telescopes get early warning. The authors simulate lensed binary neutron star and neutron star-black hole mergers detectable in the O5 run and compute LSST light curves, finding about 60% of BNS kilonovae and 10% of NSBH kilonovae visible in one exposure. This is a population simulation built on model assumptions, not an observation.
title: Leveraging Lensing-driven Early Warnings: Joint Detectability of lensed Gravitational Waves and their LSST Optical Counterparts
